content:
Podopieczni Carlesa Martineza zmierzą się na wyjeździe z chorwackim gigantem GNK Dinamo Zagrzeb w piątej kolejce Ligi Europy.

content:
Leny Yoro został ukarany czerwoną kartką po tym, jak został wyrzucony z boiska w przegranym 4:0 meczu Man Utd z Liverpoolem.

Szef Pro Ref Howard Webb zgodził się z tą decyzją, ale FA wykluczyła zawieszenie na jeden mecz po apelacjach Man Utd; United wykorzystało jako dowód czerwoną kartkę Pascala Strujka dla Brighton Związek Piłki Nożnej opublikował pisemne powody, dla których czerwona kartka Leny'ego Yoro dla Manchesteru United w Liverpoolu została unieważniona, mimo że organ sędziowski Pro Ref stwierdził, że decyzja na boisku była słuszna.

Yoro został wyrzucony z boiska za powalenie napastnika Liverpoolu Alexandra Isaka jako ostatniego obrońcy poza polem karnym, po czym sędzia Sam Barrott wyrzucił go z boiska za odmowę oczywistej okazji do zdobycia bramki (DOGSO), a VAR John Brooks zgodził się z decyzją.

title: "There are certainly options" – Eberl keeps door open to January transfers at Bayern
summary: Bayern Munich's injury problems came into sharp focus on Wednesday as a depleted side suffered a 2-1 defeat to LOSC Lille in the Champions League, bringing their unbeaten start to the season to an end. With key
content:
Bayern Munich's injury problems came into sharp focus on Wednesday as a depleted side suffered a 2-1 defeat to LOSC Lille in the Champions League, bringing their unbeaten start to the season to an end.

With key players such as Harry Kane, Michael Olise and Alphonso Davies sidelined, the defeat only added to the growing speculation over whether Bayern might strengthen their squad in January.

Speaking to DAZN after the game, board member for sport Max Eberl left the door open to new signings, while stressing that any potential arrival would have to be a “perfect fit”.

"We'll take a look at it.

First and foremost, what's important is what the squad looks like in January," Eberl said.

title: "An absolute no-go!" – Kimmich calls out Bayern over treatment of Musiala
summary: Bayern Munich figures Uli Hoeness and Karl-Heinz Rummenigge have sparked controversy lately with comments suggesting Jamal Musiala may never return to his previous level due to his neurological condition, while
content:
Bayern Munich figures Uli Hoeness and Karl-Heinz Rummenigge have sparked controversy lately with comments suggesting Jamal Musiala may never return to his previous level due to his neurological condition, while also raising questions over the German international's salary.

The 23-year-old has since received backing from several quarters, with teammate Joshua Kimmich adding his support through an emotional statement following Bayern's 2-1 defeat to LOSC Lille in the Champions League on Wednesday.

While acknowledging that the situation is difficult from Bayern's perspective, Kimmich criticised his club's handling of it, insisting that it should have been dealt with differently.

“Generally speaking, you have to look at the situation from different perspectives.

I have absolute understanding for the fact that this is not an easy situation for a club either,” Kimmich said in the mixed zone, via iMiaSanMia.
